headline: Malangel to Malevsera
title: Malangel to Malevsera | Ice Evolution Line | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Malangel is an Ice Aniimo that smiles sweetly to sneak up on targets, then bares its fangs once the fight starts. It evolves into Malevsera, a stage three Ice Aniimo. Both work Artisanship in the Homeland, at level one for Malangel and level three for Malevsera. Aniimo gg suggests pairing it with Glacy. Will you raise this Ice line? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Malangel to Malevsera: an Ice evolution line with Artisanship Homeland work (level 1, then level 3). Aniimo.gg suggests Glacy as a partner. Checked on aniimo.gg and Aniimo Wiki.
